wordpress: Download your preconfigured ZIP below. Keep the file zipped. If this chat is already installed with a snippet, keep that installation instead of adding the plugin.

Confirm your WordPress administration address, then open Plugins → Add New Plugin. Choose Upload Plugin, select the ZIP and choose Install Now. On WordPress.com, Plugins → Upload may install and activate it in one step.
Choose Activate Plugin. The plugin adds this shop’s chat to the public website footer.
Return to this workspace and check the published website. A download or activation report does not confirm installation or a delivered request.
wix: Use a published Wix site with a connected domain, and sign in to its dashboard.
Open Settings → Custom Code (under Development & integrations) → Add Custom Code. Paste the installation code below.
Under Add Code to Pages choose All pages, under Place Code in choose Body – end, then choose Apply.
Return here and check the published website.
squarespace: Use a Squarespace plan that supports Code Injection: Core, Plus or Advanced, or an eligible legacy plan. Open your website settings, then Code Injection.
Paste the installation code below into Footer, then Save.
Footer code is added to every page when saved. Open your published website to make sure it still looks right.
Return here and check the published website.
webflow: Open your Webflow site settings, then Custom code. Custom code needs an eligible paid Site plan or Workspace.
Paste the installation code below into Footer code, then Save changes.
Publish the site. Custom code only appears on the published site.
Return here and check the published website.
shopify: Open Shopify administration → Online Store → Themes. Keep a backup before editing theme code.
Open the current theme’s … menu → Edit code → Layout → theme.liquid. Add the installation code below once, just before </body>.
Choose Save. If you edited a theme copy instead of the current theme, publish that theme.
Return here and check the published website.
other: Sign in to the tool that publishes your business website. You need access to its site-wide custom code.
Find the shared footer or body-end custom-code setting. Add the installation code below once, before </body>, for every page.
Save and publish the change. If your builder only adds code inside one page section, such as a GoDaddy Websites + Marketing HTML section, ask your web person before using it.
Return here and check the published website. If your builder cannot add site-wide scripts, ask your web person to install it.
